<!--
The title must follow Conventional Commits, such as "fix(cache): count revalidated entries once". With squash merge it becomes the commit message on main and decides the next version: the allowed types are in "Commit messages and pull request titles" in CONTRIBUTING.md.

This description becomes the body of that commit. Say what changes and why; a change in behavior comes with tests and with the documentation updated.

For a change that breaks the configuration, the CLI or another public interface, add ! after the type or scope, and end the description with the migration footer described in CONTRIBUTING.md, with nothing after it. Anywhere else in the description, start no line with that footer or with a type and a colon: release-please would read a breaking change or an extra entry. Delete this comment.
-->
